diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Sunday 8 PM"] --> CLOSED["📋 Fetch Closed Trades\nThis Week"]
  CLOSED --> STATS["📊 Compute Stats\nWin rate, avg return, vs SPY"]
  STATS --> GATE{"10+ closed trades?"}
  GATE -->|"No (Phase 0)"| LOG["📝 Log Analysis\nRead-only"]
  GATE -->|"Yes (Phase 1)"| WEIGHT["⚖️ Adjust Weights\n+/- 5% per factor"]
  WEIGHT --> SAVE["💾 Save to strategy_config"]
  CLOSED --> REASSESS["🔄 Reassess Open Positions\nUpdate price targets"]
  REASSESS --> EXIT_EARLY{"Score < 40?"}
  EXIT_EARLY -->|"Yes"| FLAG["🚩 Flag for Early Exit"]
  EXIT_EARLY -->|"No"| RAISE{"Score >= 65 + rising?"}
  RAISE -->|"Yes"| UP["📈 Raise price_target +5%"]
  RAISE -->|"No"| HOLD["⏳ Hold unchanged"]

SCHED.label: Sunday 8 PM
SCHED.description: Weekly batch — runs once per week. Sufficient cadence for learning; daily would overfit to noise.
SCHED.addReason: Weekly is right cadence for learning. Daily = overfit to noise. Monthly = too slow.
SCHED.changeReason: Moved from no schedule to Claude Code scheduled task

CLOSED.label: Fetch Closed Trades
CLOSED.description: Fetches all paper_positions closed this week with outcome, realized_pnl, agent_label.
CLOSED.addReason: Learning requires ground truth — actual outcomes of trades.

STATS.label: Compute Stats
STATS.description: Win rate, avg return, avg holding days, vs-SPY comparison, per-model breakdown (Claude vs DeepSeek).
STATS.addReason: Summary statistics needed before weight adjustment.

GATE.label: Phase Gate
GATE.description: 10+ closed trades required before Phase 1 weight mutation activates. Below threshold = Phase 0 read-only mode.
GATE.addReason: 10 trades is minimum for statistical meaning. Adjusting weights on 2-3 trades would be noise-driven overfitting.

LOG.label: Log Analysis
LOG.description: In Phase 0: writes weekly summary to learning_log table. No weight changes. Builds evidence base.
LOG.addReason: Even without weight changes, logging builds the dataset needed to eventually tune weights.

WEIGHT.label: Adjust Weights
WEIGHT.description: In Phase 1: if fundamental signals correlated with wins → +5% weight. If sentiment correlated with losses → -5%. Max change ±5% per factor per week.
WEIGHT.addReason: Continuous improvement — agent gets better at picking winners over time.

SAVE.label: Save to strategy_config
SAVE.description: Writes updated weights to strategy_config table. ResearchAgent reads fresh weights on next run.

REASSESS.label: Reassess Open Positions
REASSESS.description: Checks latest agent_signal for each open paper position. If signal changed significantly, update price_target.
REASSESS.addReason: Positions older than 7 days may need target revision based on new signal data.

EXIT_EARLY.label: Early Exit Check
EXIT_EARLY.description: If latest signal score < 40 or direction flipped to SELL → flag position for early exit (exit_reason=llm_exit).
EXIT_EARLY.addReason: Thesis can break mid-trade. Weekly reassessment catches broken theses before stop-loss hits.

FLAG.label: Flag for Early Exit
FLAG.description: Sets exit_reason='llm_exit' on paper_position. Position monitor picks it up and closes on next run.
FLAG.addReason: LearnerAgent doesn't close positions directly — delegates to position monitor for clean separation of concerns.

RAISE.label: Raise Target Check
RAISE.description: If signal score >= 65 and rising, raise price_target by 5%. Let winners run further when thesis is strengthening.
RAISE.addReason: Fixed targets cut winners too early. Dynamic targets let strong thesis plays reach full potential.

UP.label: Raise price_target +5%
UP.description: Updates paper_positions.price_target *= 1.05 and sets target_updated_at = now().
UP.addReason: Concrete target revision to let winners run.

HOLD.label: Hold Unchanged
HOLD.description: Score between 40-64 = hold with current target unchanged.
